question.name: CSEC Chem Jan 2024 Q1b/c — Solubility Table: Balance Readings and Mass Dissolved
question.text:
Marcus investigated the solubility of potassium nitrate (KNO₃) at different temperatures. He weighed a beaker containing 100 cm³ of water (mass = 110 g), added KNO₃ until no more dissolved at a set temperature, and reweighed.

Balance readings from Figure 1 (mass of beaker + salt solution):

  • 10°C: 146 g (already recorded — given for you)
  • 20°C: ___ g
  • 30°C: ___ g
  • 40°C: ___ g
  • 50°C: ___ g
  • 60°C: ___ g
  • 70°C: ___ g

Part (b): Record the mass of beaker + salt solution for each temperature. (5 marks)
Part (c): Calculate the mass of KNO₃ dissolved = (beaker + salt solution) − 110 g. The first one is done for you: 146 − 110 = 36 g (3 marks)
